WINFAIL073 has no win or fail section. Its event_0/event_1 are the two choice branches and both chain to unconditional event_2, so the formal battle ends by event completion and never invents a win_0 condition.

beaten 席德爾 056 asks 雷特 to kill him; STORY073 ends on actSelectInsertEvent — 選擇一

chain into event 2 (the 斐達克 town events 168-178, track 42 / point 44 hidden,

so the seed is a battle-kind level with no battle body and no skip_battle row.
